lockPackageEntries.explanation: A manifest change prunes orphaned lock entries only during a real resolve. Resolution is blocked in this environment by the xlsx override tarball (see README), so the orphaned entries remain. They are unused and bun accepts the lock under --frozen-lockfile. A plain `bun install` with normal access to cdn.sheetjs.com will prune them; CI runs --frozen-lockfile, which does not.

bundleReport.note: main.cjs and the pi bundle were not rebuilt in this batch; the renderer was rebuilt after the change and is unchanged.
